title: 第3章 初猎银月兔 踏启灵途路第4章 临海巧制器 浅滩战灵蟹
lines: 天刚泛起鱼肚白，清晨的薄雾如一层轻柔轻纱，笼罩着整座琉璃岛。微凉的海风穿过层层叠叠的枝叶，携着露水与草木的清冽气息，缓缓拂过无尽东海沿海浅滩。空气里除了海水淡淡的咸腥，还萦绕着一丝陌生世界独有的灵韵，细微而绵长，让人一呼一吸间，都能感受到这片天地与地球的截然不同。
经过一夜在白沙滩临时营地的休整，罗止正和李紫云的体力恢复了些许，可饥饿感却比昨夜更加强烈，肠胃一阵阵空落发紧，不断提醒着他们必须尽快寻找食物。只靠椰子和少量海鲜，根本撑不住两个人在荒岛上的消耗。
罗止正撑着还有些酸痛的身体缓缓站起身，活动了一下僵硬的肩膀，目光沉稳地扫过依旧昏暗的树林边缘。
罗止正神色凝重，语气低沉：“我去附近林子边上找找吃的，你在这里等着，别乱走。”
话音刚落，衣角便被一只微凉的小手轻轻攥住。
李紫云眼底满满都是依赖与不安，小小的身子微微发颤。
李紫云脸色发白，声音细弱却坚定：“我跟你一起去，我不要一个人待在这里。”
在这座陌生又危险的琉璃岛上，只要离开他半步，她便会被无边的恐惧彻底吞没。对她而言，他在哪里，安全就在哪里。
罗止正见状心软，语气放缓：“好。那跟紧我。”
他下意识将高大的身影挡在她身前，像一堵沉稳可靠的墙，把所有未知与危险都隔在外面。
两人沿着沿岸密林缓缓前行，一路向东，进入一片地势开阔、树木稀疏的林间空地。这里海风通畅，光线明亮，地面铺满腐叶与枯枝，视野几乎没有遮挡。
这里，正是碧叶林东边——临海空坪。
也是这片沿海密林最外围、相对安全的区域。
此地坐落于无尽东海沿岸密林东侧，与无尽东海沿岸浅滩直线相距约五公里。
四周草木葱郁，无数地球上从未见过的奇花异草静静生长，有的叶片泛着淡蓝微光，有的花朵飘散着淡淡异香，每一处细节都透着不属于现实世界的神秘与原始。李紫云紧紧抓着罗止正的衣角，大气都不敢喘，一双眼睛警惕地打量着四周，脚步放得又轻又小，生怕惊动什么可怕的存在。
走了约莫一炷香的时间，林间依旧安静得有些反常，只有风吹树叶的沙沙声。就在两人以为暂时安全时，李紫云忽然脚步一顿，轻轻拉了拉罗止正的衣袖。
李紫云压低声音，神色紧张：“你看……那边有只小动物。”
罗止正立刻停下脚步，全身肌肉悄然绷紧，顺着她示意的方向望去。
前方半人高的草丛中，正蹲着一只形似兔子的生物。它身形只比普通野兔大两圈，浑身覆盖着淡银色的绒毛，耳尖带着淡淡的月白纹路，在微弱晨光下泛着细碎柔光，耳朵尖长剔透，一双眼眸竟是鲜艳如血的红宝石，模样温顺又可爱，看上去毫无威胁。
这正是银月兔，凡级一阶初期灵兽。
李紫云眼神微柔，小声惊叹：“好漂亮……好像兔子。”
紧绷的心弦稍稍放松，脸上露出一丝难得的柔和。在接连惊吓之后，能看到这样温顺可爱的灵兽，让她紧绷的情绪难得舒缓了一瞬。
可罗止正却瞬间沉下脸色，眼神凝重如冰。
罗止正眉头紧蹙，声音压得极低：“这不是寻常的野兔，有危险，离它远点。”
他话音刚落，那只兔子像是被气息惊动，头顶长耳猛地一竖，温顺的外表瞬间褪去，一股凶戾之气悄然散开。
它显然早已凭借本能察觉到威胁，反应速度骤然变得异常迅捷。
这正是警觉本能！
下一刻，它没有丝毫逃窜之意，反而后腿猛地一蹬，身形骤然爆射而出！速度快得只剩下一道银亮残影，几乎瞬间就冲到近前，利爪直扑而来！
这正是利爪猛扑！
罗止正脸色骤变，厉声喝道：“小心！”
罗止正反应极快，猛地将李紫云往身后狠狠一拽。

情急之下，李紫云被拽得身形骤失平衡，脚下一滑重重踉跄倒地，手腕狠狠擦过地面粗糙的碎石与枯根，立刻划出一道细长血口，鲜血缓缓渗了出来；膝盖也重重磕在凸起的硬木上，裤腿磨破一大块，皮肉泛红破皮，阵阵刺痛瞬间蔓延开来。她还没来得及呼痛，就被罗止正牢牢护在身后，眼睁睁看着那灵兽狠狠撞在旁边粗壮的树干上，整棵大树剧烈摇晃，树皮当场裂开数道细纹，碎石与枯叶簌簌掉落。李紫云吓得脸色发白，心脏狂跳不止，手腕与膝盖的伤口也跟着阵阵抽痛。
罗止正眼神锐利，沉喝出声：“它看着温顺，其实极其好斗，速度极快！”
罗止正全身肌肉紧绷，进入最高戒备的战斗状态。
content_en:
The sky was just turning white, and the early morning mist was like a soft veil, covering the entire Glazed Island. The cool sea breeze passes through the layers of branches and leaves, carrying the refreshing scent of dew and vegetation, and slowly blows across the endless shoals along the East China Sea. In addition to the faint salty smell of sea water, there is also a trace of the unique aura of a strange world lingering in the air. It is subtle and long, making people feel how completely different this world is from the earth with every breath.
After a night's rest at the temporary camp on the white sand beach, Luo Zhizheng and Li Ziyun recovered a little bit of their physical strength, but their hunger was stronger than last night. Their stomachs felt empty and tight, constantly reminding them that they must find food as soon as possible. Just relying on coconuts and a small amount of seafood cannot sustain the consumption of two people on a desert island.
Luo Zhi stood up slowly while holding on to his still aching body, moved his stiff shoulders, and glanced steadily at the edge of the still dim woods.
Luo Zhizheng's expression was serious and his tone was low: "I'm going to look for food at the edge of the nearby forest. You wait here and don't wander around."
As soon as he finished speaking, the corner of his clothes was gently grasped by a cold little hand.
Li Ziyun's eyes were full of dependence and uneasiness, and his little body was trembling slightly.
Li Ziyun's face turned pale, and his voice was thin but firm: "I'll go with you, I don't want to stay here alone."
On this strange and dangerous Liuli Island, as long as she took half a step away from him, she would be completely swallowed up by boundless fear. For her, safety is where he is.
Seeing this, Luo Zhizheng softened his heart and softened his tone: "Okay. Then follow me."
He subconsciously blocked the tall figure in front of her, like a steady and reliable wall, keeping out all unknowns and dangers.
The two of them walked slowly along the dense forest along the coast, heading east, and entered a forest glade with open terrain and sparse trees. The sea breeze here is smooth, the light is bright, the ground is covered with rotten leaves and dead branches, and the view is almost unobstructed.
Here is the east side of Biyelin - Linhaikongping.
It is also the outermost and relatively safe area of ​​this coastal dense forest.
This place is located on the east side of the dense forest along the coast of the Endless East China Sea, about five kilometers away from the shoals along the coast of the Endless East China Sea.
The surrounding vegetation is lush, and countless exotic flowers and plants that have never been seen on earth grow quietly. Some leaves glow with a light blue shimmer, and some flowers exude a faint fragrance. Every detail reveals a mystery and primitiveness that does not belong to the real world. Li Ziyun tightly grasped the corner of Luo Zhizheng's clothes, not daring to breathe. He looked around with his eyes warily, and his steps were light and small, for fear of disturbing some terrible existence.
After walking for about a stick of incense, the forest was still unusually quiet, with the only sound of the wind rustling the leaves. Just when the two of them thought they were safe for the time being, Li Ziyun suddenly stopped and gently pulled Luo Zhizheng's sleeve.
Li Ziyun lowered his voice and looked nervous: "Look... there is a small animal over there."
Luo Zhizheng immediately stopped, his muscles all over his body tensed quietly, and he looked in the direction she indicated.
A creature that looked like a rabbit was crouching in the grass half as tall as a man in front of him. It is only two circles larger than an ordinary hare. It is covered with light silver fluff. The tips of its ears have faint moon-white lines, glowing softly under the weak morning light. The tips of its ears are long and clear, and its eyes are as bright as blood rubies. It looks docile and cute, and does not look threatening.
This is the Silver Moon Rabbit, an early-stage mortal-level spiritual beast.
Li Ziyun's eyes were soft and she exclaimed in a low voice: "So beautiful... like a rabbit."
The tense heartstrings relaxed slightly, and a rare softness appeared on his face. After being frightened one after another, seeing such a docile and lovely spirit beast made her tense mood soothed for a rare moment.
But Luo Zhizheng's face instantly darkened, his eyes as solemn as ice.
Luo Zhizheng frowned and said in a very low voice: "This is not an ordinary hare. It is dangerous. Stay away from it."
As soon as he finished speaking, the rabbit seemed to be alarmed by the breath, and the long ears on its head suddenly stood up. Its docile appearance instantly faded away, and a ferocious aura quietly dispersed.
It had obviously already sensed the threat by instinct, and its reaction speed suddenly became extremely fast.
This is the alertness instinct!
The next moment, it didn't have the slightest intention of running away. Instead, it kicked its hind legs violently, and its body suddenly shot out! The speed was so fast that only a silvery afterimage was left. He rushed forward almost instantly, and his sharp claws rushed towards him!
That's it for the claw swoop!
Luo Zhizheng's expression suddenly changed and he shouted sternly: "Be careful!"
Luo Zhizheng reacted very quickly and violently pulled Li Ziyun behind him.
In desperation, Li Ziyun was pulled out of balance. His feet slipped and he stumbled to the ground. His wrists violently scraped against the rough gravel and dead roots on the ground, immediately creating a slender bloody opening, and blood slowly seeped out. His knees also hit the protruding hardwood, and a large piece of his trouser leg was torn. The flesh was red and broken, and bursts of pain spread instantly. Before she could cry out in pain, Luo Zhizheng was firmly protecting her behind her. She watched helplessly as the spirit beast slammed into the thick tree trunk next to her. The whole tree shook violently, the bark cracked into several fine lines on the spot, and gravel and dead leaves fell. Li Ziyun's face turned pale with fright, his heart was beating wildly, and the wounds on his wrists and knees were throbbing with pain.
Luo Zhizheng's eyes were sharp and he shouted: "It looks docile, but it is actually extremely aggressive and very fast!"
Luo Zhizheng's muscles tensed up and he entered the highest alert fighting state.
title_en: Chapter 3: The first hunt for the Silver Moon Rabbit and embarking on the spiritual journey Chapter 4: Ingenious craftsmanship at the seaside, fighting spirit crabs in the shoals
